overview: The carbonite-rich founding world of the Empress Teta system and early Unification Wars.
history:
Koros Major appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Koros Major shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Koros Major remains a reference point in Deep Core surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
notableEvents: Surveyed during the Old Republic expansion into Deep Core
Referenced in Clone Wars and Imperial era records
Documented in Knights of the Old Republic archives
Listed in Old Sith Empire star charts
